data.name: aaidah
data.gender_notes: aaidah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘A’A’D, meaning ‘to guide’ or ‘to inform’. In Islamic tradition, Aaidah symbolizes a guide, a sign, or a reminder towards the righteous path and the remembrance of Allah. The name is also found in the Quran in various contexts, such as the mention of Prophet Ibrahim’s wife Hajar as ‘Aaidah, the Wife of the House,’ and the description of the Prophet Yunus as ‘the one who guided [to the truth].’
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of guidance and remembrance of Allah
data.etymology: aaidah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Symbol, Sign.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of aaidah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
